name: JAREES (Nanchang Jiaruiya Technology Co., Ltd.)
summary: PETG-heavy Amazon filament brand whose USPTO JAREES mark (reg. 6379542, June 2021) is owned by Nanchang Jiaruiya Technology Co., Ltd. in China, though in Class 9 rather than the filament class. Sells high-speed, tough, matte, transparent, rainbow, wood and metallic PETG plus silk, high-speed and PLA+ PLA. Extruder unknown.

product_lines.name: PETG High Speed / Tough / High Transparency
PETG Matte / Rainbow / Metallic
product_lines.notes: Effect PETGs; no PETG effect ids exist.

product_lines.name: PETG Wood Fill
product_lines.notes: Wood-filled PETG; the wood-fill id is PLA-based, so only the PETG base is recorded.

additional_notes: Store is Amazon US, where JAREES is listed as manufacturer; no brand website found. No relationship to any extruder found.

provenance.conflicts: Trademark record read on Justia 2026-11-06: JAREES (serial 90215355, registered 2021-06-08) is Class 9 only, owned by Nanchang Jiaruiya Technology Co., Ltd., Nanchang, Jiangxi. The record does not cover filament, so the owner-to-filament link stays weaker than usual.
